bio: Does the name Les Deux sound familiar? Following in the footsteps of his Munich original, Fabrice Kieffer's sophisticated concept has now also made its way here. Chef Marc Fröhlich specialises in classics such as pâté en croûte and steak au poivre, as well as more modern dishes (eg braised beetroot, feta, frisée, pomegranate). Wolfgang Hirn, meanwhile, manages the service team, and does so with style, expertise and charm. The atmosphere is elegant yet lively, making for a certain bistro vibe. You can also simply enjoy a glass of champagne at the beautiful bar. There is a small terrace in front of the building....
